title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to an earlier Arms Sales Notification (notice document 2025-22602, Federal Register page 57751, December 12, 2025); an incorrect graphic of a letter on page 57752 is replaced. The corrected letter itself is only provided as an image and its text is not included.
summary: This Federal Register notice is a correction, not a new arms sale. It replaces an incorrect graphic of a letter (page 57752) in the December 12, 2025 arms sales notice 2025-22602. The notice does not state the purchasing country, items, values, or the date delivered to Congress in its text, since those details are in the corrected image.
